name: Smartweed leaf-flower
desc: Smartweed leaf-flower (Phyllanthus polygonoides): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 7 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Phyllanthus polygonoides, known as smartweed leaf-flower or knotweed leafflower, is an herbaceous perennial plant in the family Phyllanthaceae. It grows from 10 to 50 centimeters in height.
